Flow.description: Gives the portal logins of a business's Owners, Managers and School Administrators read access to the business, its licenses, business applications, violations and fees, and removes that access from portal logins no longer related in one of those roles. Manual shares to staff are left alone, and a record's owner gets no share. Run in the background by Record-Trigger: Account After Save when Portal Access Sync Pending is ticked. A sharing set can't tell relationship roles apart, which is why this keeps share records instead.
